located_point.method: Site index point retained (Wikidata 'Navinal railway station'). Rawat 2015 (PDF page 19) prints a coordinate for Navinal whose minutes and seconds place it about 1.5 km north-west of the station if the degrees are read as 22 deg N. The composite shows the coastal plain, a highway, salt flats and fields; no Harappan feature was identified.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: the site has no published plan of straight architecture available to us, and no straight feature could be identified as Harappan
sources.rights_notice: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026

notes: The only held figure of Navinal is panel E of Abhayan et al. 2025 Fig. 2, an outline of the surface exposure drawn over a commercial basemap; it shows no walls and is excluded. No excavation plan was found.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan of straight Harappan architecture found, and no imagery feature could be identified.
